name: M3_OIS320MI_GetPriceLine
description: Retrieve a single sales price and discount breakdown for one customer and item, optimized for use when adding or updating an order line. This call simulates pricing based on the same pricing logic as the interactive price simulation, but in a streamlined, single-line form that is faster than the more advanced GetPrice call. It evaluates factors such as customer, item, quantity, dates, price list, discount model, facility, warehouse, and optionally delivery address, and returns sales price, net price, discounts, promotions, campaigns, kit details, and (optionally) costing and margin information. No data is created or updated; the call only returns calculated values for the supplied input line.
